name: Wolverine Stack
description: The most-studied multi-peptide combination in tissue repair research. BPC-157 upregulates VEGF and nitric oxide for blood vessel formation while TB-500 regulates actin for cell migration. Two complementary stages of the healing cascade.

name: GH Pulse Stack
description: Gold standard growth hormone optimization. CJC-1295 hits the GHRH receptor while Ipamorelin activates the ghrelin receptor — two pathways producing 2-3x the GH release of either alone, without raising cortisol or prolactin.

name: Cognitive Edge
description: Stress-cognition axis. Semax upregulates BDNF and dopaminergic signaling for focus and memory. Selank modulates GABA receptors for calm without drowsiness. Both intranasal — easy to dose mid-day.

name: Extended Wolverine
description: Adds GHK-Cu's collagen synthesis (up to 70% increase in Type I/III collagen) on top of the Wolverine stack. Three complementary mechanisms with zero receptor overlap.

name: Longevity Protocol
description: Aging hit at three layers. Epitalon activates telomerase for telomere maintenance. GHK-Cu stimulates collagen and broad gene-resetting activity. BPC-157 provides systemic cytoprotection.

name: Immune Defense
description: Three layers of defense, minimal overlap. TA1 boosts adaptive immunity (T-cell maturation). LL-37 disrupts bacterial and viral membranes directly. KPV suppresses excessive inflammation via NF-κB.

name: Performance Stack
description: Four non-overlapping pathways supporting high-volume training. Wolverine stack accelerates tissue repair while CJC/Ipamorelin elevate GH for systemic anabolism and protein synthesis.

name: Body Composition
description: Fat loss while preserving lean mass. AOD-9604 enhances fat metabolism via beta-3 adrenergic receptors without raising IGF-1. CJC/Ipamorelin elevate GH for muscle preservation.

name: Joint Recovery
description: Tendon, ligament, and cartilage repair. BPC-157 drives growth factor upregulation. GHK-Cu promotes Type III collagen synthesis. AOD-9604 provides anti-inflammatory action at the joint without IGF-1 elevation.

name: Gut + Immune
description: Gut-immune axis from three angles. BPC-157 protects and repairs GI mucosal lining. KPV reduces intestinal inflammation. TA1 supports systemic immune function.

name: Pulse GH (Non-DAC)
description: Mimics natural pulsatile GH rhythm. Same GHRH+GHRP synergy mechanism as the DAC stack but with shorter-acting Mod GRF. Often dosed before bed.

name: Full Recovery
description: Post-surgical or significant injury protocol. Wolverine stack for tissue repair, GHK-Cu for collagen remodeling, Ipamorelin for GH-mediated protein synthesis. Inflammation, cell migration, extracellular matrix, and systemic recovery covered.
